body.statement:
For an integer symmetric positive-definite coefficient matrix augmented by
integer right-hand sides, the Bareiss fraction-free elimination recurrences
without pivoting make only exact integer divisions, and every transformed
coefficient is a signed bordered minor of the augmented input matrix.

source.locator: Section I, equations (3)--(7), together with the one-step integer-preserving elimination developed in Section II
source.verbatim_statement: We note the important property that when all a_ij's are integers, a_ij^(k) is also an integer. This is obvious from (3).

attestation.note: Verified against the official AMS open-access scan of Bareiss (1968), p. 566, Section I, equations (3)--(8); the bordered-minor definition is equation (3), equation (6) gives the fraction-free recurrence, and the text immediately following equation (6) states integrality/exact divisibility. Cross-checked against the author’s 1966 Argonne report ANL-7213, Sections I–II, DOI 10.2172/4474185.
